description: This source file defines the MenuFactory class within the org.apache.ofbiz.widget.model package. It contains methods to load, parse, and retrieve menu models from XML resources, leveraging caching mechanisms and handling resource resolution within web applications and location-based contexts.

classes.name: MenuFactory
classes.description: A factory class for loading and retrieving menu models from XML resources, supporting webapp and location-based contexts with caching.

methods.name: getMenuFromWebappContext
methods.description: Retrieves a ModelMenu object from a web application resource, involving cache lookup and XML parsing.

methods.name: readMenuDocument
methods.description: Parses a Document object representing a menu XML file and constructs a map of menu names to ModelMenu instances.

methods.name: getMenuFromLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a ModelMenu object based on a resource location and visual theme, with cache management and XML parsing.
